svg.title: vLLM's API server and engine core, with their tasks, threads, sockets and queues
svg.desc: Two large boxes side by side. The API server on the left holds three asyncio tasks, a handler task above an output handler task above a socket task, joined upward by the outputs queue and the collector. The engine core on the right holds an input thread, a main thread and an output thread, joined downward by input_queue and output_queue, with a GPU box beside the main thread. A ZMQ arrow runs from the handler task to the input thread, and another from the output thread to the socket task. A caption notes that the busy loop also keeps batch_queue and aborts_queue.

g.text: ROUTER to DEALER on the way in, PUSH to PULL on the way out
the busy loop also keeps batch_queue and aborts_queue
asyncio tasks on the left, threads on the right
